## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure: Python graph BatchNorm tests.

## Summary

Add 163 deterministic FP8 cases to `test/python/norm/graph/batchnorm_fusion_cases.py`, all marked L1. Cover BN, BN+ReLU, BN+Add+ReLU, and their backward patterns across 11 shapes with batch size 400.

- Forward: E4M3 and E5M2 inputs/outputs.
- Backward: E4M3/E4M3, E5M2/E5M2, and E4M3/E5M2 activation/gradient types.
- Preserve the original eight cases, including IDs and seeds; exclude the two already-covered FP8 combinations.
- Generate stable IDs and seeds so inserting or reordering cases does not change existing inputs.

## Why

The existing FP8 coverage has one forward and one backward case. Expand the shape and dtype matrix using the existing graph builders and independent references, without adding another test harness. Reuse checks for outputs, statistics, gradients, masks, and AMAX.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

No production API, graph-builder, reference, or CI scheduling changes. Existing cases and capability checks are unchanged. Unsupported configurations skip; numerical failures remain failures.

## Testing

Verified 171 unique fusion cases, stable IDs/seeds, and unchanged original cases. Together with the four existing tests in `test_batchnorm.py`, the focused suite has 175 tests.

Serial validation with a local cuDNN backend build (CUDA 13.2 Debug):

| GPU | Result | Pytest elapsed time |
|---|---|---:|
| NVIDIA H100 | 175 passed | 30.83s |
| NVIDIA B100 | 175 passed | 22.24s |
| NVIDIA L40S | 109 passed, 66 expected capability skips | 19.33s |

All three runs used the same source, local backend build, Python environment, and serial pytest command on October 15, without instrumentation and with warm compilation caches. L40S skips 66 cases requiring newer hardware, so the executed workloads differ. These are single-run pytest times, including setup and references, not performance benchmarks or qualification of all released cuDNN versions.

Run from `test/python`:

```text
python -m pytest norm/graph/test_batchnorm.py norm/graph/test_batchnorm_fusion.py \
  -o "addopts=" -m "L0 or L1" --tb=short --no-header

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Tests**
  * Expanded automated coverage for FP8 batch normalization across additional shapes and supported forward and backward data types. Tests now also account for hardware capability requirements and use consistent test parameters to help detect regressions.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

detail.title: Expand deterministic FP8 BatchNorm fusion coverage.

files.patch:
@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@
 
 from dataclasses import dataclass
 from enum import Enum, auto
+from hashlib import sha256
 from typing import Optional, Tuple
 
 import torch
@@ -164,3 +165,64 @@ def parameter_shape(self) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int]:
         uses_fp8=True,
     ),
 )
+
+
+def _fp8_expansion_cases():
+    shapes = (
+        (400, 128, 56, 56),
+        (400, 256, 14, 14),
+        (400, 512, 28, 28),
+        (400, 1024, 14, 14),
+        (400, 64, 56, 56),
+        (400, 128, 28, 28),
+        (400, 512, 14, 14),
+        (400, 512, 7, 7),
+        (400, 2048, 7, 7),
+        (400, 256, 56, 56),
+        (400, 256, 28, 28),
+    )
+    forward_types = (("e4m3", FP8_E4M3), ("e5m2", FP8_E5M2))
+    backward_types = (
+        ("e4m3_e4m3", FP8_E4M3, FP8_E4M3),
+        ("e5m2_e5m2", FP8_E5M2, FP8_E5M2),
+        ("e4m3_e5m2", FP8_E4M3, FP8_E5M2),
+    )
+    existing_ids = {case.case_id for case in BATCHNORM_CASES}
+    for pattern in BatchNormPattern:
+        types = tuple((name, dtype, None) for name, dtype in forward_types) if pattern.is_forward else backward_types
+        for shape in shapes:
+            n, c, h, w = shape
+            for dtype_name, input_dtype, grad_dtype in types:
+                case_id = f"{pattern.name.lower()}_n{n}_c{c}_h{h}_w{w}_{dtype_name}"
+                # Retain the original parameters and seeds for already covered problems.
+                # Symbolic IDs also remain distinct when PyTorch lacks an FP8 dtype.
+                if case_id in existing_ids:
+                    continue
+                if pattern == BatchNormPattern.BN:
+                    rtol, atol = (0.2, 0.5) if dtype_name == "e4m3" else (0.25, 0.25)
+                    mismatch_rate = 0.0
+                elif pattern.is_forward:
+                    rtol, atol = 0.2, 0.2
+                    mismatch_rate = 0.002 if pattern.has_add else 0.003
+                else:
+                    rtol, atol = 0.25, 0.25
+                    mismatch_rate = 0.0
+                yield BatchNormCase(
+                    case_id=case_id,
+                    # Identity-based seeds do not shift when cases are inserted or reordered.
+                    seed=int.from_bytes(sha256(case_id.encode("ascii")).digest()[:4], "big"),
+                    pattern=pattern,
+                    shape=shape,
+                    input_dtype=input_dtype,
+                    output_dtype=input_dtype if pattern.is_forward else grad_dtype,
+                    level="L1",
+                    rtol=rtol,
+                    atol=atol,
+                    min_compute_capability=(9, 0) if pattern.has_backward_mask else (8, 9),
+                    max_mismatch_rate=mismatch_rate,
+                    grad_dtype=grad_dtype,
+                    uses_fp8=True,
+                )
+
+
+BATCHNORM_CASES += tuple(_fp8_expansion_cases())
